_readme: Copy to ~/.config/dsh-discord-relay/config.json, chmod 600, and replace EVERY value. channelId/ownerId/secret are required; port, userAgent and dshProfile are optional. Get both ids from Discord with developer mode on (right-click the channel / your avatar -> Copy ID). dshProfile is the dsh profile bin/dsh-relay launches - any profile works once the bundle is installed into it; omit it and the wrapper uses DSH_RELAY_PROFILE, else headless. Never commit the real file.
